theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (α K : ℝ) (F : ℕ → Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)) (V : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ)), 0 < α → 0 ≤ K → (∀ z, Tendsto (fun j => F j z) atTop (𝓝 (V z))) → (∀ z z' : Rn n, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ‖F j z - F j z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) → (∀ z z' : Rn n, ‖V z - V z'‖ ≤ K * ‖z - z'‖ ^ α) ∧ Continuous V
